question: Which prominent world leader joined Truth Social (a social media platform owned by US President Donald Trump) in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi**, the Prime Minister of **India**, joined **Truth Social**, a social media platform owned by former US President **Donald Trump**, in **March 2025**.
 
• Truth Social is a social media platform launched by **Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG)** with the aim to provide an alternative space for free speech and conservative voices.
 
• Modi's decision to join the platform was seen as a step to enhance diplomatic relations between India and the United States, and to connect with a wider global audience.
 
• Truth Social has gained popularity among political leaders and figures globally for its promise of unrestricted expression and resistance to censorship prevalent on mainstream social media platforms.
 
• This move is part of Modi's strategy to leverage digital platforms for global outreach and communication, aligning with his leadership's emphasis on technology-driven diplomacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi:**

 
 
• Born on **17 September 1950**, Narendra Modi is the **14th Prime Minister of India**, serving since **May 2014**.
 
• Known for his strong emphasis on **digital transformation**, he has launched initiatives such as **Digital India** to connect India digitally.
 
• Modi has a significant presence on social media platforms such as **Twitter, Facebook**, and **Instagram**, showcasing his global outreach strategy.
 
• His leadership style is characterized by a focus on **economic reforms, international diplomacy**, and leveraging technology for governance.
 
 
 
• **Truth Social:**
 
 
• Launched in **February 2022**, Truth Social is a social media platform developed by **Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG)**.
 
• The platform aims to promote **free speech** and provide a space for conservative voices that often face censorship on other platforms.
 
• It has attracted several political figures and influencers globally, particularly from right-wing or conservative ideologies.
 
• Truth Social operates as an alternative to mainstream platforms like **Twitter** and **Facebook**.
 
 
 
• **Global Digital Diplomacy:**
 
 
• Many global leaders, including **Narendra Modi**, use digital platforms for diplomacy and outreach, helping them connect with citizens and international audiences.
 
• Digital diplomacy includes the use of social media channels to address global issues, foster international relations, and promote national interests.
 
• Platforms like **Twitter** and **Truth Social** have become critical tools for leaders to communicate directly with people worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Donald Trump:**
 
 
• Donald Trump served as the **45th President of the United States** from **2017 to 2021**.
 
• He launched Truth Social as a part of his media and technology group to counter censorship and promote free speech.
 
• Trump has been a prominent user of social media, often using platforms to directly communicate with the public.
 
• His initiatives like Truth Social aim to create platforms that align with his political and ideological goals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Political Leaders on Social Media:**

 
 
• Social media platforms have become vital tools for political leaders to engage with their constituencies and global audiences.
 
• Platforms like **Truth Social** and **Twitter** allow leaders to share their viewpoints, policies, and achievements directly.
 
• Such platforms also play a significant role in shaping public opinion and fostering international communication.
 
• Leaders joining new platforms often signify shifts in diplomatic or political strategies to reach specific audiences.
 
 
 
• **Digital Outreach in Politics:**
 
 
• Digital outreach is increasingly critical in politics, enabling direct interaction between leaders and citizens.
 
• It helps leaders bypass traditional media channels and communicate their messages unfiltered.
 
• Such initiatives are vital for building transparency and fostering public trust.
